summary.text: Cherlyn Smith is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 25, running against incumbent Republican Steve Bratcher in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A technical writer, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Cherlyn Smith earned a bachelor's degree from Everest University in 2006, and her career experience includes working as a technical writer.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she works as a technical writer and IT auditor consultant at TEK Systems.

She wrote that from 2008 to 2022 she owned a screen printing shop, event hall and consulting firm in Hardin County, and that she spent 21 years as a Drug and Alcohol Prevention Coordinator and Budget Officer with the Department of Defense.
She also said she previously worked as a case manager for the State of Florida in the Welfare Reform Program.
Smith lost the 2024 general election for Kentucky House District 25.
In the survey she named access to healthcare, including mental health services and reproductive healthcare, the local economy and public education funding among her priorities.
